messages:
maria: quick question — for the embeddings endpoint, are we going to require clients to send a per-request dim hint (e.g. `X-Embed-Dim: 1536`) or should the router infer dims from payload and attach it to routing keys?

jonathan: leaning toward an explicit header. inference router needs dims early to pick a shard/variant; inferring requires parsing the whole payload which is extra cpu and complicates preflight. header makes routing deterministic and cheap.

adele: +1 for header from console POV. we can surface a warning if header missing and we had to infer. UX: show a per-request note that says "dim inferred" vs "dim provided" and cost estimate.

samir: implementation caveat — if we accept header we still need to validate it against actual vector shape on the dedicated path. otherwise ppl will send wrong dims to get routed to cheaper models. validation can be async but we need a fallback path (reject vs recalc route).

maria: agree. proposal: require `X-Embed-Dim` for non-streaming batch endpoints. If missing, do a preflight parse with `413` soft-fail + guidance message to client to add header. That keeps fast path fast.

jonathan: can we make the preflight logic in the gateway so runtime doesn't pay? gateway already sees body size; adding a light parse to sample first item to get dim seems reasonable. but sampling might mislead for mixed-dim payloads. we need rules for mixed dims.

lucy: telemetry considerations: we should emit `embed.dim`, `embed.items`, `embed.bytes`, and a `routing.hint_source` tag (`header|inferred|mixed|missing`). dashboards can then show cost per-dim and heatmap of hint sources. also add `splitter.reason` metric when we split client payloads.

samir: for mixed dims the router should prefer to fast-fail the request (400) unless client opts into auto-split mode by header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true`. Auto-split will route pieces to appropriate shards and stitch results. We'll need to add quota accounting per-subrequest.

adele: console UX: add a per-route toggle for "allow autosplit" with explanatory copy: "Automatically split mixed-dim payloads. May increase token/unit billing due to multiple model variants." Also show a sample of how results will be merged.

maria: sample header snippet I had in mind:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dim: 1536
X-Embed-AutoSplit: true
X-Client-Request-Id: abc123
{ "inputs": [[...], [...]] }
```

jonathan: routing key change: include `dim` and `autosplit` in the hash. existing fairshare needs to be updated to avoid cross-contending slots for different dims. That implies updating metrics and sharder mapping table.

lucy: telemetry event idea: emit `embed.route_decision` with fields (as tags) `dim`, `route_variant`, `hooked_fallback` (true/false), `hint_source`. We'll then make a dashboard tile called "route decision drift" to detect when hint_source flips a lot.

samir: ops note — quota billing: if autosplit causes N subrequests to different model variants, bill to the parent request owner and tag each subrequest with `parent_request_id`. Need to ensure dedicated pools honor that tag for quota enforcement.

infra-bot: deploy queued: feature/embeds-dim-header (staging) -> expected deploy 2026-03-22T04:00Z.

adele: one last product ask — when we reject vs soft-413, include an exact example client payload and suggested header values in the error body so SDKs can auto-retry with header. small DX win.

maria: sounds like we have alignment. I'll draft an RFC w/ the API contract (headers, autosplit semantics, error codes) and include telemetry + console toggles. Assigning to samir/jonathan for infra work and adele/lucy for UX/telemetry.

jonathan: will start a sharder PR tomorrow. planning note: need a migration window for sharder table changes and a compatibility flag to let old clients without header keep working for 6 weeks.

samir: +1 on migration window. I'll schedule capacity tests against mixed-dim synthetic workload.

adele: tagging product-review for next week.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
